GB/GiB conversion factor is about 1.074, insufficient to explain an 18-to-48 ratio.
Nominal 32 billion times four bits divided by eight is 16 billion bytes; block and mixed-layout overhead must be separate.
Exact tensor count gives 16.381 GB ideal four-bit and 65.524 GB bf16; file is 30.8% of bf16 and 4.933 bits/element.
